_metadata.description: BigClaw Nuclear Renaissance Portfolio — Sector Whitelist
_metadata.reactor_coverage: 94 operating reactors at 54 sites across 28 states. ~76% owned by publicly traded companies. TVA (7 reactors) is federal. A few reactors are owned by public power/cooperatives (Columbia-WA, Cooper-NE).
_metadata.purpose: yfinance sector/industry fields cannot reliably identify nuclear companies. This manually curated whitelist is the authoritative source for sector gate (G1) in the Nuclear Renaissance portfolio.
_metadata.market_cap_gate: $3B (companies below this are tracked on watchlist but not eligible for purchase)
_metadata.review_frequency: quarterly or when new nuclear IPOs/SPACs emerge

eligible._note: Market cap >= $3B. Eligible for purchase subject to other gates.

nuclear_utilities.name: Constellation Energy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Largest US carbon-free generator. 21 reactors. Three Mile Island restart.

nuclear_utilities.name: Vistra Corp
nuclear_utilities.notes: Comanche Peak (2 reactors) + acquired Energy Harbor 2024: Beaver Valley (2), Davis-Besse (1), Perry (1). Total 6 reactors.

nuclear_utilities.name: Exelon Corp
nuclear_utilities.notes: Largest US nuclear fleet operator (post-CEG spin). Regulated utility.

nuclear_utilities.name: Southern Company
nuclear_utilities.notes: Vogtle 3&4 operator — only new-build nuclear in US.

nuclear_utilities.name: Dominion Energy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Millstone, Surry, North Anna nuclear stations.

nuclear_utilities.name: PSEG
nuclear_utilities.notes: Salem and Hope Creek nuclear stations.

nuclear_utilities.name: Entergy Corp
nuclear_utilities.notes: Grand Gulf, Waterford, River Bend nuclear stations. 3 reactors.

nuclear_utilities.name: Talen Energy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Susquehanna nuclear plant (2 reactors). Data center co-location pioneer.

nuclear_utilities.name: Duke Energy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Brunswick, Catawba, McGuire, Oconee, Harris. 10 reactors across NC/SC.

nuclear_utilities.name: NextEra Energy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Point Beach, Seabrook, St Lucie, Turkey Point. 7 reactors via FPL.

nuclear_utilities.name: Xcel Energy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Monticello, Prairie Island. 3 reactors in MN.

nuclear_utilities.name: Pinnacle West Capital (APS)
nuclear_utilities.notes: Palo Verde — largest US nuclear plant, 3 units, ~3,937 MW. APS is largest co-owner (~29%).

nuclear_utilities.name: PG&E Corp
nuclear_utilities.notes: Diablo Canyon — 2 reactors. License extended past planned 2024-25 closure.

nuclear_utilities.name: Evergy
nuclear_utilities.notes: Wolf Creek — 1 reactor in KS. ~47% owner.

nuclear_utilities.name: American Electric Power
nuclear_utilities.notes: Donald C. Cook — 2 reactors in MI.

uranium_mining_fuel.name: Cameco Corp
uranium_mining_fuel.notes: World's largest publicly traded uranium producer and fuel services.

uranium_mining_fuel.name: NexGen Energy
uranium_mining_fuel.notes: Rook I project — one of highest-grade uranium deposits globally.

uranium_mining_fuel.name: Denison Mines
uranium_mining_fuel.notes: Athabasca Basin uranium development. Wheeler River project.

uranium_mining_fuel.name: Centrus Energy
uranium_mining_fuel.notes: Sole US uranium enricher. HALEU production for advanced reactors.

nuclear_manufacturing_services.name: BWX Technologies
nuclear_manufacturing_services.notes: Naval nuclear reactors, TRISO fuel, medical isotopes. Only US manufacturer of naval reactor components.

nuclear_manufacturing_services.name: GE Vernova
nuclear_manufacturing_services.notes: BWRX-300 SMR developer. Nuclear is minority of revenue — primarily gas turbines, wind, grid. Provides portfolio diversification.

nuclear_manufacturing_services.name: Fluor Corp
nuclear_manufacturing_services.notes: Nuclear engineering and construction. Vogtle experience.

nuclear_manufacturing_services.name: Jacobs Solutions
nuclear_manufacturing_services.notes: Nuclear decommissioning, operations support, NRC regulatory services.

nuclear_manufacturing_services.name: Curtiss-Wright
nuclear_manufacturing_services.notes: Nuclear reactor components, instrumentation & controls, defense nuclear.

smr_developers.name: Oklo Inc
smr_developers.notes: Aurora micro-reactor. Sam Altman backed. NRC application resubmitted.

smr_developers.name: NuScale Power
smr_developers.notes: Only NRC-certified SMR design (VOYGR). Idaho project cancelled; seeking new flagship.

watchlist._note: Market cap $500M-$3B. Tracked for growth potential. Not eligible for purchase until market cap exceeds $3B.
